key_insight: PixelMoE shows that LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts can work effectively in pixel-space diffusion, letting these models scale capacity without making every inference step fully dense. In simple terms: you can make image diffusion bigger and stronger while only activating part of the model at a time.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the scaling bottleneck of pixel-space diffusion models, where increasing model capacity usually also increases active computation. This makes dense scaling expensive and limits efficiency compared with sparse expert-based designs.
method: Adapt standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts layers to pixel-space diffusion models.
Route image tokens/features to a subset of experts so only part of the network is active per step.
Build PixelMoE as a sparse, scalable diffusion architecture for raw-pixel generation.
impact: This matters because it offers a practical path to larger, more capable image diffusion models without proportional compute growth. For practitioners, it means better efficiency and a new architecture option for scaling high-quality pixel-level generative models.

paper_title: PixelMoE: Scaling Pixel-Space Diffusion with LLM-Style Mixture-of-Experts
paper_authors: Ruixiao Dong, Jianmin Bao, Bozhi Luan, Zijie Meng, Xin Tao
